content.title: Intel Stock Surges to 4-Year High Ahead of Earnings. Why Optimism Is Growing.
content.summary: Intel  stock gained again on Wednesday ahead of the chip company’s earnings report.  Intel shares were up 11.7% at $54.25 for the session, their highest close since January 2022.  Intel is expected to report adjusted earnings of eight cents a share on revenue of $13.42 billion for the fourth quarter of 2025, according to a FactSet poll of analysts’ estimates.

content.title: How The Story For HSBC Holdings (LSE:HSBA) Is Shifting As Analysts Rework Expectations
content.summary: HSBC Holdings has seen its fair value estimate nudged up to £11.25 from £10.88, a change that reflects slightly more constructive analyst views on how the story could play out from here. The update lines up with a cluster of higher price targets from research houses that view recent results and cost discipline as enough to justify a modestly higher valuation, even as some analysts stay cautious and stick with Neutral style ratings. content.title: HSBC's Roberts Says AI Won't Lead to 'Massive Layoffs'
content.description: Michael Roberts, head of corporate and institutional banking at HSBC, discusses geopolitical risks, the bank's restructure and the impact of artificial intelligence on staffing. "I don't think it'll lead to massive layoffs," Roberts says. "I don't think it'll lead to massive change in how we do things other than as to make it more efficient," he adds. Roberts speaks on Bloomberg Television at the World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland.
